excerpt: ZCode 是 AI 编程工作台，提供桌面应用、浏览器界面和终端 Agent。
统一使用 `zcode` 启动：无参数进入 TUI；第一个参数为 `--web` 时启动 Web；其他参数交给现有 Agent CLI 处理。
zcode --web --workspace /path/to/project --port 3030 --no-open
局域网访问可使用 `--host 0.0.0.0`；监听非本机地址时默认生成访问令牌，使用终端输出的带令牌链接。可通过 `--token` 指定令牌或 `--no-token` 关闭令牌认证。
远程功能（SSH/WSL）... 连接远程项目时资源选择「本地下载后上传」
从 Excalidraw 的画布协作示例开始，了解插件安装更新、页面 API 和宿主联调入口。
`ZCODE_BUILTIN_PROVIDER_CONFIG_FILE` 本地 Provider 配置文件路径；未设置时使用内置配置
`ZCODE_DATA_BASE_DIR` 应用数据基目录，数据写入其下的 `.zcode/`
`--os` 支持 `mac`、`win`、`linux`，`--arch` 支持 `x64`、`arm64`
安装脚本从该地址下载运行包，默认安装到 `~/.zcode/runtime`，并在 `~/.local/bin` 创建 `zcode` 命令。
新安装不会删除旧 Lite 目录，也不会迁移或删除已有会话数据。
ZCode 是新一代氛围编程工具，多智能体协作完成复杂目标，随时随地尽在掌控。
用 Goal 管理复杂目标，持续规划、执行与验证，让多步骤工作稳步推进。
通过微信、飞书或 Telegram 远程唤起 ZCode，让任务随时进入执行状态。
GLM-5.3-Flash 同步接入，截图理解、看图分析等多模态任务开箱即用。
支持 ZCode、Claude Code 等 20+ 编程工具
ZCode 支持的所有平台安装包 ... MacOS ... Windows ... Linux Beta
One user found that GLM-5.2 in ZCode seems capable but is much slower than Opus.
A user was surprised ZCode is not open source, contrasting it with Xiaomi's MiMo Code, which is an open-source CLI.
UI-wise it looks much closer to Codex than Claude Code. One commenter called it 'basically an exact copy of Codex.'
ZCode comes with a small amount of free credits after login.

One user said it looks quite pretty but wasn't sure it beats OpenCode. They tried the Pro coding plan and felt it doesn't give much more quota than Opus once you count tokens needed per task. They still found GLM 5.2 'a beefier Sonnet model, pretty good.'
One user tried ZCode but went back to OpenCode, which 'feels smarter.' They noted the 1.5x usage promotion for GLM 5.2 on the coding plan makes now a good time to test it.
Complaint: it's an Electron app that highlights misspelled words but doesn't suggest corrections.
Reliability complaint: a user repeatedly got 'Cannot connect to API: write EPIPE' on about 4 out of 5 prompts, '24/7'. They ended up just sending 'retry' over and over.

A user doesn't trust ZCode as a closed-source agent with full user permissions. They prefer OpenCode with its GLM provider, where they can monitor which files were read or edited and what commands ran.
Pricing criticism: ZCode advertises a 'base usage allowance included' with higher plans as multipliers, but never discloses what the base actually is.
Commenters noted it isn't a CLI (it's GUI/desktop only), so it is more like Cursor or Conductor than Claude Code. Others asked whether a CLI version exists.
A user who calls GLM-5.2 a great model questioned the need for a dedicated harness. They run it with swival.dev, saying it works perfectly with no tool-calling issues and handles long sessions fine.
A report circulated that ZCode silently uploads users' Git history/workspace snapshots to the cloud. A commenter noted the uploaded content is encrypted with a key users don't have.
A user who tried ZCode during this month's 'free' promotion said their instinct to isolate it protected them. They felt sorry for those whose secrets may have been collected.
A user who recently began using ZCode said it 'works pretty well' but is super sketchy if it really uploads full git history. They only weren't worried because their project is already open source.
A paying GLM subscriber called ZCode 'honestly one of the best harnesses out there from an HCI perspective.' They found the upload news 'pretty gutting.'

Counterpoint: a user on ZCode since initial release found no evidence of the upload in their data. They saw no logs of capture or upload and no ~/.zcode/v2/checkpoints/ directory, suggesting it doesn't affect everyone.
A user said they will keep using it despite the news. They recommend wrapping the harness in sandbox-exec/agent-safehouse or running it under a separate user account.
The site loads in Chinese, and on mobile there's no obvious way to switch to English. Another user pointed to the English docs at zcode.z.ai/en/docs/welcome.
A commenter criticized the upload report for confusing git history ('git log') with the git repository, which is what was actually reportedly uploaded.
